headline: Employment of 89.5 % is near the benchmarks, but full-time work is clearly lower at 65.8 %.
how_to_read: Flows run from all respondents (left) to employed or not employed (middle) and then to detailed situation (right); width is the share of respondents. The hatched "Hidden" flow marks details held back because fewer than 3 people fall into them.
key_findings: Full-time work accounts for 65.8 % and self-employment for 10.5 % of the 89.5 % employed.
The 10.5 % not employed include no students or other situations; seeking work, not seeking work and retired are hidden.
benchmark: Employment is 1.8 pp below Asia (91.3 %) and 3.1 pp below all schools (92.6 %). Full-time work trails Asia (74.6 %) by 8.8 pp and all schools (74.9 %) by 9.1 pp.
caveats: At n = 38 one person moves the percentages by a few points, and part-time, other employment and several non-employed categories are hidden.
